breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction to "Use pimpleFoam as a single solver for both fluid and solid domains on a combined mesh." This is the core error described in the inconsistency, as pimpleFoam is a fluid solver and cannot handle the solid mechanics of the elastic flap.
